verdict.rationale: The repository documents an explicit `yy skills update` command. It selects the latest compatible stable release and updates all three agent copies, so no reinstall from scratch is needed. The docs also say customized or unrecorded copies are flagged for review rather than silently deleted. Skills are independently versioned. Missing for 10: documented marketplace auto-update behavior, independent or hands-on corroboration of the update flow.

support.subject: As a developer, there is a documented update path — marketplace auto-updates or an explicit update command — so I get fixes without reinstalling from scratch

citations.quote: Run `yy skills install` or `yy skills update` explicitly to select the latest compatible stable release and update all three agent copies.
Unrecorded legacy copies remain preserved and flagged, not silently deleted.
This repository is the canonical, independently versioned source for skills used by YYLO CLI, YYLO Ledger and YYLO Benchmark.
